title: JWT Attacks
description: Three main techniques: none algorithm, weak keys, and kid injection
detail:
1. alg=none: remove the signature segment (affects older libraries)
2. Weak key: brute-force with a dictionary using jwt_tool / hashcat -m 16500 (secret/key/123456/uuid)
3. kid injection: point kid to a file or an SQL injection path
4. Algorithm confusion RS256→HS256: use the public key as the HMAC secret
Modify the payload: role admin / user id 1. Edit manually with jwt.io, paying attention to base64url encoding.
